title: Opening: joining Louis Armstrong and Lionel Hampton
summary: Jackson starts on joining Armstrong, who was on his way to California to play at Sebastian's, and recalls Lionel Hampton as a Chicago boy.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: So you were talking about when you joined Louis Armstrong.
Yeah, Louis came back. By the time Louis came back I had been studying on the Roy and Dutre. First one, first one I could catch. That was it.
Wait a minute. Okay, it's going now. Can you tell about when you joined Louis?

When I joined Louis, yeah. Louis came back. He was on his way to California to play at Sebastons. Which later became famous and one of the Chicago musicians became famous. And that was Lionel Hampton. That's the boy I remember walking around Chicago.
